mapper.select: SELECT h.paper_history_id, h.paper_history_owner_user_id, h.paper_history_paper_id, h.paper_history_paper_no, h.paper_history_version, h.paper_history_action, h.paper_history_hash, h.paper_history_create_time, h.paper_history_create_by FROM edu_paper_history h WHERE h.paper_history_paper_id = #{paperId} ORDER BY h.paper_history_version DESC, h.paper_history_id DESC
